retention.purpose: Hold the Ember paid-media setup profile long enough to stand up Meta measurement, build the first campaign, and complete one optimization cycle; the profile has no purpose beyond that window and is re-created rather than extended.

evidence_refs: Classification is 'public' by scope, not by accident. This run directory is deliberately limited to facts already published on ember-jo.netlify.app, structural observations about the site, and non-numeric operator decisions. No encryption control is required for that data class.
Deliberately held OUTSIDE this artifact: the paid-media budget figure, and any future target CPA, ROAS, or margin numbers. Those live in operator conversation only.

Observed 2026-08-01: this workstation has no full-disk encryption. Get-BitLockerVolume (elevated) reported C: and E: as FullyDecrypted / ProtectionStatus Off / EncryptionMethod None. D: is a fixed 856 GB NTFS volume and is BitLocker-eligible but was not shown as encrypted.

Escalation rule: the moment a credential, customer list, audience file, account export, or any commercially sensitive number needs to be stored here, this classification is void. Re-classify to confidential or restricted and obtain verified at-rest encryption first.

deletion.method: Recursive delete of .claude-ads/runs/setup-20260801-ember-meta/ from the local workstation, including any rendered Markdown, HTML, or PDF copies produced from it, followed by a directory-absence check.

incident.reporting_channel: Private direct message to the Ember business owner on the existing WhatsApp thread used for project delivery; contact details are held outside this repository.
